comment: Service-side cron + event-driven program manifest. Source of truth: convex/agents/packs/maya-service/standingOrders.ts. Per-business jobs.json is rendered at deploy time by buildJobsJson() with the operator's timezone interpolated into `tz`. This file is the un-interpolated catalog — `tz` is `OP_TZ` placeholder; the deploy pipeline replaces it. Sibling-file scan: every `entryId` here MUST have a matching standing-order block in AGENTS.md AND a matching skill folder under agents/skills/maya-service-*/. Plan-tier filtering is applied at deploy time per `business.plan`.

jobs.name: Competitor watch
jobs.message: Run competitor watch: ScrapeCreators sweep of named competitor GBPs, call `maya-service-competitor-watcher` for digest, fold into Monday morning brief.
jobs.description: Sundays 9am: weekly digest of named competitor GBP changes.

jobs.name: Content rejuvenation
jobs.message: Run content rejuvenation: scan `mediaAssets` + recent job photos, call `maya-service-content-rejuvenator` for 3 repurposing ideas, push to `gbpPosts.suggestions[]`.
jobs.description: Sundays 2pm, surface 3 repurposing ideas from the operator content library.

jobs.name: Daily content check
jobs.message: Run daily content check: scan `mediaAssets` last 48h; if empty, soft check-in via primary channel. Skip on Sundays.
jobs.description: Mon-Sat 8am: if no fresh photos in 48h, soft check-in via primary channel.

jobs.name: Engagement watch
jobs.message: Run engagement watch: pull GBP + FB + IG inbound, identify operator-unanswered > 2h, draft reply via `maya-service-lead-response-nudger`, ping for approval.
jobs.description: Every 2h waking hours: GBP/FB/IG inbound DMs unanswered > 2h get a draft reply.

jobs.name: GBP cadence watch
jobs.message: Run GBP cadence watch: if last `gbpPosts` post > 5 days, draft via `maya-service-gbp-post-optimizer` (recent job photo OR service-tip seed), write with `status='pending_approval'`.
jobs.description: Every 3 days at 10am, ensure last GBP post isn't > 5 days old; draft if it is.

jobs.name: Lead response alarm
jobs.message: Run lead response alarm: scan `inboundLeads` aged > 2h with no operator response, send single SMS nudge via `maya-service-lead-response-nudger` (max 4/day total across all unsolicited outbound).
jobs.description: Every 30 min 24/7: missed leads > 2h with no operator response → 1 SMS nudge.

jobs.name: Local event watch
jobs.message: Run local event watch: pull local events + weather + sports scores for served neighborhoods, surface 1-2 high-fit hooks. Fold into evening recap.
jobs.description: 6pm daily: surface 1-2 local hooks (events, weather, sports) for tomorrow's content.

jobs.name: Manager-readiness packet
jobs.message: Run quarterly manager-readiness packet: assemble businessPicture + 90d metrics + brand-voice + reviews + content cadence, call `maya-service-packet-generator`, render PDF, push link.
jobs.description: Quarterly auto + on-demand: full packet for hiring a real marketing manager.

jobs.name: Morning brief
jobs.message: Run morning brief: pull today's schedule + overnight reviews + fresh leads, draft brief with one cited insight + one action + pending approvals, write `dailyBriefs`, push to primary channel. Stay under 200 words.
jobs.description: Daily 7am push: today's schedule + overnight reviews + fresh leads, cited.

jobs.name: Revenue snapshot
jobs.message: Run revenue snapshot: CRM pull last 7d completed jobs + paid invoices + outstanding, call `maya-service-revenue-snapshot-renderer`, push to `revenueSnapshots`.
jobs.description: Mondays 9am: prior-week revenue snapshot from CRM jobs + invoices (CRM-required).

jobs.name: Review followup
jobs.message: Run review followup: scan `reviewRequests` aged 3d or 7d with no matching review, draft softer followup via `maya-service-review-request-drafter`, append to `reviewRequests.followups[]`.
jobs.description: Day-3 + day-7 review-followup nudges to customers who haven't reviewed yet.

jobs.name: Seasonal nudge
jobs.message: Run seasonal nudge: read serviceType + current month + 90d job-mix, call `maya-service-content-arc-planner` for 2-3 season-relevant angles. Cite historical demand where available.
jobs.description: Mondays 9am: 2-3 season-relevant content angles for this service type.

events.name: Job-completion review request
events.description: On CRM `job.completed`, draft + queue (Starter) or send 24h after (Pro+) a review request.

events.name: Review reply (drafted, NEVER auto-posted)
events.description: On a new GBP/FB review, draft a reply within 30 min and ping operator for approval.

events.name: Weather-triggered promo
events.description: On NWS storm/heat-wave/freeze alert in service area, draft urgency post for approval.
